intro: Brightloom Games' office, wired from the scan. The miner talks to its pool over the network, so the cable is the quickest off switch.

tasks.text: Cut the mining server off the network, but keep it running for the investigation
tasks.hint: Pull its cable or shut its switch port. Leave it powered on: the miner and its persistence are still in memory.

tasks.text: The developers still reach Git and the internet
